name: Architectural Matte Black Ornamental Picket Railing / Barandilla Ornamental Negra
finish_color: Matte Black with Gold Knuckle Accents
description_es: Barandilla arquitectónica de barrotes verticales con canal superior decorativo de anillos y postes cuadrados reforzados con remate piramidal. Diseñada para balcones, porches y escaleras exteriores de alta durabilidad en climas de New Jersey y New York.
description_en: Architectural vertical-picket railing featuring an ornamental top ring channel and heavy-duty square newel posts with pyramid caps. Engineered for residential and commercial decks, balconies, and stairs across New Jersey and New York.
features: Postes estructurales cuadrados con tapa piramidal y base de anclaje reforzada
Canal superior decorativo con anillos ornamentales y detalles centrales
Acabado negro mate resistente a la corrosión e intemperie (NJ/NY)
Fotografía procesada sobre fondo blanco puro (#FFFFFF) para catálogo
kit_includes_note: Kit de sección de 6 pies (36" de altura) incluye riel superior/inferior, barrotes y soportes.
flow_prompt_suggestion: Studio product photography and architectural showcase of a Architectural Matte Black Ornamental Picket Railing (Aluminum Railing), crafted from Powder-Coated Aluminum in a Matte Black finish. Crisp vertical balusters, structural top and bottom rails, square newel posts with pyramid caps, isolated on a pure seamless white studio background (#FFFFFF), even softbox commercial catalog lighting, ultra-sharp architectural metalwork details, 8k resolution.
